Departures from the design, each to meet the task's rule О23 or the rule of the red messages (0112 О24). (a) Design 4.1 gives teamOptions(folders, env = {}) and builds the second server of `failure` as { ...teamOptions(folders), stateEnv: … }; built: teamOptions(folders, { env, data }) with `data` as its own parameter, so no options are spread at any call site (О23). (b) The refusal rows of `stand` (b) are made by teamOptions too: the data row with { data } inside the repository, the trap and scenario rows with a changed copy of the folders object ({ ...folders, trap: <repository trap> }, { ...folders, scenario: <repository scenario> }); only recorded starts may use such options. (c) The starter is called in two helpers that refuse options not made by teamOptions or changed after it (a frozen object known by a WeakMap) and refuse a real start whose options are not made from the frozen folders of the test: this is what makes the gate's V03d red; the gate's literal V03d text (a field added to '...teamOptions(folders),' at the call) cannot apply to a file without that spread, so it was applied in the form the file allows (summary, mutants), with V03e for the folders form. A start that calls startStand directly with a spread would bypass both helpers; that is not a runtime fact: TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR and RELEASE-VALIDATOR check it by reading (О29): startStand( and withStand( each appear once, in teamStand and withTeam. (d) The refusals and the recorded start read only the error code (startCode) instead of assert.rejects with a validation function that returns the error: under my mutant T05 that form printed the kit's PATH_REFUSED message, which holds the refused value, here the whole PATH of the spec process (AP-152, 0112 О24); the 77 red and green outputs of the final series were searched for the PATH entries and for the home path (a planted line as the control) and hold none. (e) The second server of `failure` gets a reduced end check (the trap marker absent, no project folder, no row with the mark) since its list never loads (О14); the design names only trapStarted there. (f) Additions within the meaning: PATH of the server equals the PATH of the spec process (stand c); «Есть ли проблема» includes the reason of the failed row; the INSIDE check also needs a height above 0; untilStopped asserts { code: 0, signal: null } for both servers of `failure`. None weakens a check of the design.
